description: The setup instruction for a new install's root entry files: the copied bundle project specifics are replaced, not extended.

protocol.environment: A disposable folder holding the bundle's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md as SETUP.md copies them, plus a few files of a small invented project. The agent gets only the setup skill's entry-file instructions and does the entry-file step. Approval is supplied as a scripted turn.
protocol.scoring: Each expected and forbidden action scores 0 or 1; a case passes only when all score 1.
protocol.unavailable: Unrun cases are recorded not-run, never pass.

cases.input: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md still carry the bundle's own Project specifics. Do the entry-file step for the invented project.
expected: Replaces the Project specifics section in both files with facts about the invented project
Keeps the workflow sections above it, including the caveman response-style section
forbidden: Keeps any product, architecture, technology or verification statement about the ai-workflow-portable bundle in Project specifics
Deletes or rewrites a workflow section above Project specifics
